{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm
treatment_df = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of patients who responded
num_responded = treatment_df['responded'].sum()
num_treatment = len(treatment_df)
fraction_responded = num_responded / num_treatment

# Print all relevant numbers
print(f"Total treatment arm patients (deduplicated): {num_treatment}")
print(f"Number who responded: {num_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
